integrity: A complete exact finite acyclic discrete-Morse certificate, signed integral attaching-degree reduction and independently computed mod-two ranks are supplied. Scientific results are attributed only to this calculation, without external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the labelled order-three partial Latin-square complex. No all-order topology formula, equivariant module computation or independent audit is asserted. Bibliographic incompleteness of unindexed work remains possible.
title: Thirty-eight four-spheres in the order-three partial Latin-square complex
